notes: the first branch («وجدت في كتابي عن أبي أسامة») takes Abu Usama from his book; the two branches meet at Hisham («حدثنا هشام، ح» and «عن هشام»), and the names after the second Hisham are the shared tail (rule 3)
«أبيه» is Hisham's father, named only by relation (rule 7)
«قالت قال لي رسول الله» makes Aisha the last link; the Prophet is the end
